data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002 claims the two derivations must agree modulo 9 and asserts the intermediate complement equals 252, but the stated refutation condition conflates two different levels of the count. The PIE intermediate (the count of non-distinct three-digit numbers) is 252, yet SRC_002's condition about 'either derivation yields a different residue modulo 9' is vacuous as a refutation: because both derivations count the same set of size 648, no internal discrepancy modulo 9 can arise unless the count itself changes. The substantive relation it names ('share mechanism as two independent derivations') is under-specified — it never states what the shared mechanism IS beyond 'both count the same set,' which is an identity claim, not a mechanism. The genuine shared mechanism (positional constraint on one forbidden symbol) is left unarticulated.
